questions.question: Dr. Samira receives a patient who vigorously disputes the amount of their fees. Dr. Malika advises a structured approach. According to Article 30 of the Code of Ethics, what is the first step to follow?
options: Provide clear and detailed explanations about the fees
Refer the matter to the disciplinary council
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Article 30 requires providing explanations about fees. Transparency is the first step in conflict resolution.' Dr. Samira: 'I will take the time to explain everything.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who threatens to file a complaint for an aesthetic result they find unsatisfactory. Dr. Samira advises offering mediation. What is the advantage of this approach?
options: Avoid an expensive court proceeding and preserve the patient relationship
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Mediation allows finding an amicable solution. It is less expensive and preserves the relationship with the patient.' Dr. Malika: 'I will propose mediation.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira is confronted with a patient who refuses to pay an invoice they consider excessive. Dr. Malika reminds her of the principles of ethical billing. What is the fundamental principle?
options: The patient must pay without asking questions
The estimate must be clear and accepted before treatment
The dentist can change prices after treatment
The patient can choose not to pay
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The prior estimate is an ethical obligation. It protects both the patient and the dentist.' Dr. Samira: 'I will check that the estimate was signed.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who complains about a lack of information. Dr. Samira advises checking the signed documents. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the dentist's duty to inform?
options: Inform the patient of risks only after treatment
Provide informed care in accordance with scientific data
Let the patient find out for themselves
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Article 24 requires the dentist to provide informed care. Information is a permanent duty.' Dr. Malika: 'I will better document my information.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a dispute with a patient regarding a prosthesis that does not meet their expectations. Dr. Malika advises seeking an amicable solution. What is the first step of this approach?
options: Ask the patient to pay extra
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Active listening is the first step in amicable conflict resolution. It allows understanding the patient's expectations.' Dr. Samira: 'I will take the time to listen.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika must manage a patient who has had a post-operative complication. Dr. Samira reminds her of the importance of communication. What is the key message to convey to the patient?
options: We will take care of this complication
We must wait for it to pass
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Communication should reassure the patient and show that the practice takes the situation seriously.' Dr. Malika: 'I will clearly explain the situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira is confronted with a patient who refuses to pay part of their fees. Dr. Malika advises offering a payment plan. What is the advantage of this solution?
options: The patient can spread their payment
The patient is exempt from paying
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The payment plan allows finding a compromise while respecting the principle of direct payment of fees.' Dr. Samira: 'I will offer this solution.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who has made a complaint to the disciplinary council. Dr. Samira explains the procedure. What is the first step of the disciplinary procedure?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The disciplinary council first attempts conciliation between the parties. It is a mediation procedure before any sanction.' Dr. Malika: 'I will prepare for this conciliation.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who refuses to give consent for treatment. Dr. Malika reminds her of the principles of patient autonomy. What is the fundamental principle?
options: The patient must accept the proposed treatment
Free and informed consent is an obligation
The dentist can override the patient's refusal
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Free and informed consent is a fundamental principle of medical ethics.' Dr. Samira: 'I will respect the patient's decision.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who contests the quality of the prosthesis made. Dr. Samira advises conducting an independent expert evaluation. What is the benefit of this approach?
options: Lower the price of the prosthesis
Obtain an objective opinion on quality
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'An independent expert evaluation allows obtaining an objective opinion and resolving the conflict in an informed manner.' Dr. Malika: 'I will propose this solution.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who reported a confidentiality issue. Dr. Malika reminds her of Article 4 of the Code of Ethics. What is the dentist's obligation?
options: Ensure professional confidentiality is respected by staff
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Article 4 requires the dentist to ensure that their staff are informed of their obligations regarding professional confidentiality.' Dr. Samira: 'I will train my team.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who filed a complaint for treatment delay. Dr. Samira advises checking the records. What is the first thing to do?
options: Check the medical record and appointment dates
Ask the patient to withdraw their complaint
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Reviewing the file allows understanding the facts and preparing an appropriate response.' Dr. Malika: 'I will carefully examine the file.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who refused treatment after being informed of the risks. Dr. Malika asks her to document this information. Why is this important?
options: To prove that the patient was informed
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Documenting the refusal of treatment is proof that the patient was properly informed of the risks.' Dr. Samira: 'I will note this information in the file.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who made a complaint on social media. Dr. Samira advises responding professionally. What is the right attitude?
options: Offer private contact to discuss the problem
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'A professional response involves offering private contact to discuss the problem. This avoids publishing confidential information.' Dr. Malika: 'I will offer them an appointment.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who disputed an invoice after signing an estimate. Dr. Malika reminds her of the legal value of the signed estimate. What is this value?
options: Proof of agreement between the patient and the dentist
An obligation only for the dentist
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The signed estimate has the value of a contract. It binds both parties.' Dr. Samira: 'I will rely on this document.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who expressed dissatisfaction during a consultation. Dr. Samira advises making a record of this consultation. Why is this important?
options: To keep a record of exchanges
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The record allows keeping track of exchanges and explanations provided to the patient.' Dr. Malika: 'I will document this consultation.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who asked her to modify their medical record. Dr. Malika reminds her of ethical rules. What is the right attitude?
options: Refuse to modify a medical record
Modify the record if the patient requests it
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The medical record is an authentic document. It must not be modified retroactively.' Dr. Samira: 'I will explain to the patient that I cannot modify the file.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who refused treatment and later changed their mind. Dr. Samira advises obtaining informed consent again. Why is this necessary?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Consent must be obtained at each stage of treatment, especially if the patient changes their mind.' Dr. Malika: 'I will redo the consent.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who filed a complaint against a colleague. Dr. Malika asks her not to take sides. What is the reason for this neutrality?
options: To avoid a conflict of interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Neutrality allows preserving objectivity and avoiding a conflict of interest with the colleague.' Dr. Samira: 'I will remain neutral.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient with unreasonable demands. Dr. Samira advises managing expectations. What is the right approach?
options: Accept all of the patient's demands
Clearly explain what is possible and what is not
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'Managing expectations involves clear communication about the limits of treatment.' Dr. Malika: 'I will clearly explain the limits.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has received a formal notice from a patient. Dr. Malika advises consulting her insurer. What is the reason for this step?
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'The insurer can provide legal assistance to handle the formal notice.' Dr. Samira: 'I will contact my insurer.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who requested a copy of their medical record. Dr. Samira reminds her of data protection rules. What is the right attitude?
options: Give the file to the patient
Give the file only to a doctor
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The patient has the right to access their medical record. The dentist must provide a copy.' Dr. Malika: 'I will give them their file.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira has a patient who refused treatment and consulted another dentist. Dr. Malika reminds her of Article 53 of the Code of Ethics. What is the recommended attitude?
options: Refuse all contact with the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Article 53 encourages collaboration and joint consultation between colleagues in the patient's interest.' Dr. Samira: 'I will propose a joint consultation.'

questions.question: Dr. Malika has a patient who threatened to file a complaint for lack of information. Dr. Samira advises checking her protocols. What is the first thing to check?
questions.explanation: Dr. Samira explains: 'The signed consent form is proof that the patient was properly informed.' Dr. Malika: 'I will check this document.'

questions.question: Dr. Samira, after managing several patient conflicts, receives congratulations from Dr. Malika. What is the next step for Dr. Samira?
options: Become a reference in dental mediation
questions.explanation: Dr. Malika explains: 'Mastery of conflict management is a valuable skill. Becoming a reference in mediation is the next step.' Dr. Samira: 'I will train in mediation.'
